title: Contact
summary: Pre-bundled mailbox: guest POST /contact, account chat, admin hub. Permission messages. Tables stay kernel-named. Mail goes through the kernel email shell.

blocks.title: Shop feature, not a kernel primitive
blocks.text: Enable shows /contact and Admin → Contact. Disable unloads HTTP mounts and UI. unconnected_contacts and chat_* tables stay in kernel migrations so live PII is not moved. Product-request POST /contact/product-request belongs to tuucho-commerce-product-requests.

items.title: Guest form
items.text: Anonymous visitors on /contact. POST /contact. Stored as unconnected_contacts. Owner mail enqueued on mail_jobs through the kernel mail shell.

items.title: Account chat
items.text: Signed-in visitors on the same /contact page. chat_sessions / chat_messages, SSE, presence.

items.title: Admin Contact
items.text: Hub Registered → /admin/chats and Guests → /admin/unconnected-contacts. Permission messages on this manifest.

blocks.title: Kernel email shell
blocks.text: This plugin does not own SMTP. It calls kernel sendMail / enqueueMailJob (PluginRegisterApi.sendMail). Folder routing still writes under DEV_DIR when SMTP is off. Who receives inbound and chat-owner copies is tuucho-mail-spy rules (channels contact.inbound and contact.chat). An empty list sends nothing.

Bundled path: tuucho-config/plugins/tuucho-contact/ (public config.json, gitignored config.private.json, committed config.private.example.json). Merge matches kernel JSON (common then env, private or example). Boot does not overwrite Admin values. First launch loads files once when settings are still empty. Edit in Admin → Plugins → Configure, or Update from files / Import / Export there. Admin → Plugins Update all / Import all / Export all uses the same files (schema plugins only; no extra register).

items.description: number — public. Maximum characters for the guest name/email line on the public contact form.
number — public. Maximum characters for a contact or chat message body.
string — public. Largest image a guest may attach on /contact (for example 5m). Raise only if you accept bigger files.
string — public. Largest image in a signed-in chat (for example 5m).
number — public. How many open chat threads one account may keep. Older threads stay readable.
string — public. Public path under the media host for guest contact images. Change only if you relocated that folder.
string — public. Public path under the media host for signed-in chat images.
string — public. SMTP host that receives inbound chat mail (cPanel pipe). Leave empty if you only use the web inbox.
string — public. SMTP port for that mailbox (usually 465 or 587). Leave empty if host is empty.
string — public. SMTP username for the chat mailbox. Often the same as From email.
secret — secret. Password for the chat mailbox. Never shown after save. Type a new value only to replace it.
email — public. From address on shop replies that go out through chat SMTP.
email, public. Reply-To when staff answer a guest from admin. Leave empty to use the chat SMTP user. It does not choose spy recipients.
email — public. Address cPanel forwards inbound mail to, if you use a pipe. Leave empty without that setup.
string — public. Longest mute for owner-email copies from admin (for example 10m).
string — public. Window:max for guest contact mail (for example 15m:5). Protects the inbox from floods.
boolean — public. Turn on only on a local shop while testing. Leave off in production.
string — public. Folder where chat mail is written in development instead of SMTP. Ignore on a live host.
